source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        c = grid[r][0]
        if c != 0 and all(x == c for x in grid[r]):
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r+1:]
            if len(a) == len(b):
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        color = grid[0][c]
        if color != 0 and all(row[c] == color for row in grid):
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c+1:] for row in grid]
            if len(left[0]) == len(right[0]):
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
    raise ValueError('No symmetric solid divider found')
'''
